Parkside Financial Bank & Trust Trimmed Holding in Apple (AAPL) as Stock Declined; Delphi Management Stake in Pilgrims Pride (PPC) Has Decreased by $444,540 as Shares Declined
May 2, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Parkside Financial Bank & Trust decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 15.28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Parkside Financial Bank & Trust sold 5,065 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 28,085 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.75 million, down from 33,150 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Parkside Financial Bank & Trust who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $893.63B market cap company. The stock increased 4.15% or $7.019 during the last trading session, reaching $176.119. About 23.70M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
